reviews.name: Ivyrose Jane
reviews.text: Absolutely awful. Won’t work with you AT ALL if you’re on a budget. DO NOT waste your time.
reviews.reply:
Hi Ivyrose,
​I don't have any record of an order or client under this name in my system.
​As a small boutique bakery, all of my custom cakes are made to order directly by me. As a professional pastry chef, I handcraft each cake to ensure every detail is perfect and the quality is exceptional.
​I always try to work with a client's budget by offering different design options, provided the request meets my minimum order pricing. However, there are limits to what can be customized while keeping my business profitable and sustainable.
​When filling out the quote form on my website, clients can clearly review my Terms & Conditions, which outline how advance payments work and how pickups are scheduled before booking. I operate under a strict advance-payment policy that applies equally to all clients to ensure every order receives the proper time and preparation it deserves.
​I wish you the best!
